steps.hints: ❓Did you use the documentation for help with accessing assets from My Assets to use in tile overlap events?
steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja:


❓ What should the tile parameter of the onOverlapTile event be set to?


Solution:

The tile parameter in the onOverlapTile function should be changed from img` ` to assets.tile`treeTile`.


Ask the ninja:

❓Is the correct tilemap asset parameter used in each setCurrentTilemap function?


Solution:

The tilemap parameter in the setCurrentTilemap function inside the 2nd onOverlapTile should be changed from assets.tilemap`treeTilemap` to assets.tilemap`sunTilemap`.


Ask the ninja:

❓ What tool might be used to resize the asset after it has been duplicated?


Solution:

The Player sprite’s image should be duplicated, then renamed and resized to 32 x 32 pixels. The image argument in the setDialogCursor function should be updated with the new asset’s name.

New image that is 32 x 32
steps.instructions:
Fix the bugs in the code to create a working tilemap project!


When the Player sprite overlaps a treeTile, the treeTilemap should be displayed.


When the Player sprite overlaps a sunTile, the sunTilemap should be displayed.


The cursor image function should use its own image asset that is larger than the sprite image asset.


Use the functions in the code menu, the debug tool, and the code completion tool to create a working version of this tilemap project!

subgroups.title: Debugging Tile Overlap Events
subgroups.introduction: Oh no - these programs aren’t working! Problems in code are called bugs. Find and fix the bugs in the code in each section!

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 2 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about tilemap overlap events and how to make different things happen when sprites overlap different tiles and walls. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 2:

badges.title: The Big Event
badges.description: Use events to control what happens to sprites navigating a tilemap in a project in JavaScript.

badges.title: Touch Controls
badges.description: Make something happen when a sprite overlaps a specific tile.

badges.title: A Chain of Reactions
badges.description: Make something happen when a sprite hits a wall.

badges.title: A Glyph in the System
badges.description: Use an image asset as a cursor image in a dialog box.

badges.title: Save for Later
badges.description: Create an array to store all of the locations of a specific tile type on a tilemap.

badges.title: Invisible Walls
badges.description: Turn a wall on or off at a specific location on a tilemap.
